description.narrative: Oxfam and its partner (ADEL CD) propose to support the response to food insecurity induced by the El Ninõ and the conflict, throughFood Vouchers distribution and awareness sessions on safe programming and protection risks for 480 households in Montepuez District, Cabo Delgado Province, Northern Mozambique. ADEL CD's intervention in this project will focus on food assistance and protection, especially food vouchers distribution and raising awareness about safe programming and protection risks for people affected by conflict and food insecurity in Montepuez District, to respond to the impacts of drought induced by El Niño and conflict, which have affected several sectors, including agriculture, livelihoods and food security, etc.. The food vouchers assistance will be provided during three (3) months of project implementation. Food purchases will be prioritized locally. The rations will be in accordance with WFPand Food Security Cluster standards. Before the food voucher distribution, people will benefit from awareness sessions on safe programming and protection risks. ADEL CD is a non-profit legal entity governed by private law, founded in 2008 and legalized in July 2009 at the Registry Office of Pemba-Mozambique, page 46 of the association registration book, Q, registration N°74/14, documents N°1,Pack N° 1. It is a non-profit, independent and non-partisan organization oriented towards community development that ensures humanitarian protection and assistance to victims of armed conflicts and other situations of violence. Takes initiative in responding to emergencies and, at the same time, promotes respect for International Humanitarian Law (IHL) and its implementation in a country's national legislation. Thematic areas of intervention: Training and institutional development; Participatory Local Governance; Sustainable Management of Natural Resources and the Environment; and Promotion of Business Initiatives and Employment Generation; humanitarian action and emergencies (Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene (WASH), Early Recovery <(>&<)> Resilient Livelihoods, Food Security <(>&<)> Livelihoods, Asset Based Community Development, Social Inclusion, Empowerment and Life Skills Development) It is well integrated into the local context and works in partnership with the provincial government, local authorities and national and international partners. It has the capacity for programmatic and financial management of programs with a qualified technical team and experience accumulated over more than 10 years of existence. Mission: Encourage entrepreneurship for production and income generation, centered on the person as a factor in creating wealth for their well-being. Vision: Unite the efforts of civil society, the public and private sectors, sponsoring appropriate development options that contribute to the eradication of poverty (generation of wealth) and the elimination of social and economic exclusion. ADEL CD has a code of conduct that adapts to the PSEA issue, Son-in-law Strategies in addition to having a specific code for the PSEA issue.

participating-org.narrative: Agencia de Desenvolvimento Economico Local de Cabo Delgado (ADEL CD) is a representative organization made up of several local institutions (public and private), concerned with local economic development of Cabo Delgado Province. It is a non-profit organization with the aim of promoting local economic development of the Cabo Delgado Province, stimulating local economic forces in the search for opportunities and the economic potential of the province for their development.
